correctness.rationale: For a,b>0, even/odd deck lifts lead exactly to rho(P,Q)^2=min(U²+W²,V²+(b-W)²), with horizontal U=delta_2a(x-x'), V=delta_2a(x+x') independent Unif[0,a] under finite-covering Haar homomorphism and W=|y-y'| density 2(b-w)/b². Triangular-density integration gives g(D), D=U²-V²; symmetrization yields mean B=a²/3+b²/12-2a^4/(45b²) plus H=4/(15b²a²)∫_b^a(u²-b²)^(5/2)du for a>b (else zero). Integrated closed form and positivity yield sharp aspect threshold a=b, H~2^(11/2)/(105 b^(3/2))(a-b)^(7/2), C³ but not C⁴, and strict deficit below torus mean a²/3+b²/12. Independently re-integrated reduced three-variable distribution numerically at four aspect ratios and checked moments; the full result is analytic, not from quadrature.
